A professional product reference photograph establishing the canonical look of a recurring object (coral_lipstick).

[SUBJECT]:
A slim, elegant coral lipstick in a compact cylindrical tube, designed as a vivid hero beauty product. The casing is smooth satin coral with a narrow brushed-silver band and a matching coral cap that clicks securely into place. Inside is a classic angled bullet in saturated warm coral, creamy and highly pigmented, rising from a silver inner mechanism when twisted. The box is a small rectangular carton in the same coral color with minimal white lettering. The lipstick should remain visually identical across the bathroom, elevator, diner, and rooftop scenes.

[FRAMING]:
The object is the sole subject, centered, shown three-quarter angle at a scale that fills most of the frame. Every defining detail — shape, proportions, materials, colors, finish, and any text or branding on the object — must be clearly legible. No hands, no people, no props, no packaging unless it is part of the object itself.

[ENVIRONMENT]:
Render in Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save style. Background: clean, seamless studio backdrop with no environmental detail — simple flat or gradient tone drawn from the style's color palette: #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Color grading: Clean and bright with true-to-life color. Whites are crisp, skin tones warm and natural. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

[LIGHTING]:
Bright natural window light with clean directional shadows. Direct on-camera flash for punchy editorial energy on select shots. No heavy diffusion -- let light feel real and immediate. Warm late-afternoon glow for lifestyle moments. High-key and airy overall with pops of contrast. Even, controlled illumination that reveals true colors, materials, and surface finish.

[MATERIALITY]:
Hyper-accurate rendering of all surfaces, textures, and micro-details. Tack-sharp focus across the entire object, deep depth of field, no lens distortion. This image is the single source of truth for the object's appearance.
